subtasks: Place the yellow 9 upright and centered on the leftmost round pad using the left gripper.
Place the yellow 5 upright and centered on the second round pad from the left using the left gripper.
Place the yellow 3 upright and centered on the third round pad from the left using the right gripper.
Place the yellow 0 flat, upright and centered on the rightmost round pad. Keep the other three digits in place.
Withdraw the left hand. Use the right gripper to pick up the yellow 0 now on the table in front of the rightmost pad, straighten it upright and place it flat at the center of that pad.
Return both arms to their initial poses with both grippers fully open. First lift clear of the released 0 on the rightmost pad. Leave all four digits in place.
